subject.title: feat(ui): add a Memory settings page

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this curated Settings → Memory page as the first-class home for global memory and Dreaming controls after the write-order repair and live UI proof are complete?
rationale: The PR adds a substantial permanent Control UI information architecture surface, not only a bug fix; the protected maintainer label signals that a human should confirm the product direction independently of implementation quality.

options.title: Sponsor the curated Memory page
options.body: Retain the page design, require the ordered write repair and persisted Control UI proof, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep deep-link/search repairs but defer Dreaming or engine controls until their product ownership and write model are separately settled.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this new settings surface and keep the existing distributed controls until a maintainer-approved Memory UX plan exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the curated Memory page
recommendation.body: Retain the page design, require the ordered write repair and persisted Control UI proof, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature history shows direct ownership of the proposed Memory UI architecture and the shared slot-policy integration.
